faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Programme Support Associate (I-FETP) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Programme Support Associate (I-FETP) position at PGIMER is August 20, 2026. Ensure your application is submitted via email before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate from a recognized University. Desirable qualifications include fields like Public Health, Hospital Administration, and Business Administration.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Programme Support Associate (I-FETP) role?
faq.answer: The age limit is preferably not exceeding 40 years. Age relaxation rules may apply as per the institution's guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. How will the candidates be selected for the Programme Support Associate (I-FETP) position?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves screening of applications, followed by a written test and/or computer skill test if deemed necessary, and finally an interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Programme Support Associate (I-FETP) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of up to ₹50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. The official email address for submission is provided in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Programme Support Associate (I-FETP) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Programme Support Associate (I-FETP) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at PGIMER.

faq.question: Q9. What experience is required for the Programme Support Associate (I-FETP) role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 03 years of post-qualification experience is required in specific government or public health sectors. Experience in programme coordination and administration is preferred.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the PGIMER located?
faq.answer: PGIMER is located in Chandigarh. The recruitment is for a position within the institute in Chandigarh.
